item.title: Kochi Sunday Market (Nichiyo-ichi) — Guide
item.description: The Kochi Sunday Market, or Nichiyo-ichi, is one of Japan’s great street markets, a tradition over three hundred years old that fills a kilometre-long avenue leading to Kochi Castle every Sunday. Hundreds of stalls line both sides of the street, selling fresh local vegetables and fruit, pickles, plants and flowers, tools, antiques, street food and crafts — much of it brought in by farmers and makers from the surrounding countryside. Wandering its length is a wonderful window into everyday Kochi life, full of local colour, seasonal produce and friendly banter.
